title: knob

flags.name: -load <float>
flags.description: sets the value output at load time (default 0)

flags.name: -arcstart <float>
flags.description: sets the value the arc starts from (default 0)

flags.name: -jump
flags.description: sets to jump on click mode

flags.name: -number <float>
flags.description: sets number display mode, 0 to 4 (default 0, none)

flags.name: -numbersize <float>
flags.description: sets size of the displayed number, minimum 8 (default 12)

flags.name: -numberpos <float, float>
flags.description: sets position of the displayed number (default 0 -15)

flags.name: -var <symbol>
flags.description: assigns a [value] variable to the knob

flags.name: -savestate
flags.description: saves the current value with the patch

flags.name: -noloadbang
flags.description: doesn't output the value at load time

body: [knob] is a knob GUI: click and drag, or scroll, to change its value. It has a range with linear, exponential or logarithmic response, an optional arc and number display, ticks and discrete steps, and can be circular, jump to the clicked position or be read only. Right click for properties.
